title: SigLIP 2 готов к field-проверке — production quality решит разметка

report.originalQuestion: Каков текущий статус ML-решения и что можно честно показать в презентации?

metricDefinitions.label: SKU / rows
metricDefinitions.definition: Exact count at the named audit stage. Source rows and duplicate rows are CSV row counts; other stages are unique catalog slugs.

metricDefinitions.label: Share of unique catalog
metricDefinitions.definition: count divided by 2,103 unique catalog slugs; null when the row grain is source CSV rows.

evidenceFlow.title: Deterministic audit
evidenceFlow.detail: The catalog builder deduplicates exact rows, normalizes names for linkage, verifies content hashes, and quarantines ambiguous/shared assets without rewriting source images.

evidenceFlow.title: Strict policy
evidenceFlow.detail: The model index excludes semantic name+winery collisions and genuinely low-resolution references. Strict coverage is 928 of 2,103 SKU.

metricDefinitions.label: Top-1 accuracy
metricDefinitions.definition: Exact-slug Top-1 accuracy on 928 deterministic synthetic JPEG transforms of the same strict catalog references; not real-photo accuracy.

metricDefinitions.label: p95 latency
metricDefinitions.definition: 95th percentile single-query inference latency after three warmup iterations on RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell.

evidenceFlow.title: Scope
evidenceFlow.detail: Synthetic regression proxy only. Query transformations reuse the strict gallery sources and are not independent field photographs.

evidenceFlow.title: Decision
evidenceFlow.detail: ORB improves Top-1 by 0.108 percentage points while adding 48.61 ms to p95, so it remains disabled pending field evidence.

metricDefinitions.label: Epoch
metricDefinitions.definition: Epoch zero is the frozen-feature baseline; epochs 1–15 are adapter validation snapshots.

metricDefinitions.label: Validation Top-1
metricDefinitions.definition: Top-1 exact-slug accuracy on one deterministic synthetic validation view per gallery item.

evidenceFlow.title: Training
evidenceFlow.detail: Frozen vision tower; rank-64 residual projection; 4 training views and 1 validation view per item; best checkpoint epoch 14; seed 20260928.

metricDefinitions.label: Reviewed labels
metricDefinitions.definition: Rows with an exact reviewed product label. Zero at the snapshot cutoff.

evidenceFlow.title: Acceptance gate
evidenceFlow.detail: All 100 images have stable IDs and SHA-256 values, but remain unlabeled in the pool split. No field-quality or rejection metric is available yet.
